Shell(FIBER=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3@v3.6.1 echo "=== Config fields (subset) ===" grep -nE "^\s+(BodyLimit|ReadTimeout|WriteTimeout|IdleTimeout|ErrorHandler|StructValidator|CaseSensitive|StrictRouting|Immutable)\b" "$FIBER/config.go" | head -20 echo "=== Ctx key methods ===" grep -nE "^\s+func \(c \*DefaultCtx\) (Params|Query|Body|JSON|Status|SendStatus|Locals|Context|Bind|Set|Get|Path)\b" "$FIBER/ctx.go" | head -30)

Shell(FIBER=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3@v3.6.1 echo "=== shutdown variants ===" grep -nE "^func \(app \*App\) Shutdown" "$FIBER"/*.go | head echo "=== goose Logger iface + SetLogger ===" GOOSE=$(go env GOMODCACHE)/github.com/pressly/goose/v3@v3.29.0 grep -nE "^type Logger|^func SetLogger|Printf\(format string|Fatalf\(format string" "$GOOSE"/logger.go 2>/dev/null | head)

Shell(B=http://127.0.0.1:8099 T="Authorization: Bearer secret" J="Content-Type: application/json" code() { curl -s -o /tmp/body.txt -w "%{http_code}" "$@"; } echo "--- GET /health (no auth) -> $(code $B/health) $(cat /tmp/body.txt)" echo "--- GET /api/v1/todos (no auth) -> $(code $B/api/v1/todos) $(cat /tmp/body.txt)" echo "--- GET /api/v1/todos (bad token) -> $(code -H 'Authorization: Bearer nope' $B/api/v1/todos) $(cat /tmp/body.txt)" echo "" echo "--- POST create -> $(code -X POST -H "$T" -H "$J" -d '{"id":"0b8f4c3e-5d1a-4c52-9a7e-2f6c1e8b9d10","text":" Call the bank "}' $B/api/v1/todos)" cat /tmp/body.txt; echo echo "--- POST same id again (idempotent)-> $(code -X POST -H "$T" -H "$J" -d '{"id":"0b8f4c3e-5d1a-4c52-9a7e-2f6c1e8b9d10","text":"Different"}' $B/api/v1/todos)" cat /tmp/body.txt; echo echo "--- POST second todo -> $(code -X POST -H "$T" -H "$J" -d '{"text":"Water plants"}' $B/api/v1/todos)" cat /tmp/body.txt; echo)
